title: Adding context to type errors
description: You can follow two simulated type conflicts into located messages.

steps.description: TypeErrorMsg stores a message, line and context. You join the available fields into one readable error string.
This demonstration compares type strings with a simplified check. A caught TypeError becomes TypeErrorMsg carrying the supplied line and context.

steps.question: Which details will the first conflict print?
steps.answer: It prints line 7, the condition-of-if context and expected Int, got Bool.

steps.description: You see the first located conflict and a second at line 12 for argument 1 of concat. The second message reports expected Int, got Str.
